verdict: Not defeated on the fixture's own numbers, but the claim is weaker than stated. (1) Re-crossing after budget exhaustion is forced by construction: A1 assumes sustained non-zero-mean load with no operator change, so removal of suppression cannot fail to re-cross; that clause carries no test content. (2) 'Grows without bound' rests on three durations (4000/8000/16000 ticks) showing roughly linear cost; a finite run cannot show lim C = ∞, only non-saturation over the sampled range. (3) The operator-change zero-force result is quoted from a note's summary table, not the JSON, and 'zero force' is definitional: the fixture meters suppression force but never meters the cost of changing Γ or S_env.
